title: T2: An Adaptive Test-Time Scaling Strategy for Contextual Question Answering
authors_zh: Zhengyi Zhao、Shubo Zhang、Zezhong Wang、Huimin Wang、Yutian Zhao、Bin Liang、Yefeng Zheng、Binyang Li、Kam-Fai Wong、Xian Wu（机构：香港中文大学、国际关系学院、腾讯贾维斯实验室、西湖大学）
paper_type_zh: 面向上下文问答的自适应测试时扩展框架
best_for_zh: 研究检索支撑推理中的自适应预算与策略选择的读者。
one_line: T2 selects a question-specific reasoning strategy from analogous examples to spend more inference effort only where it is useful.
T2 从相似示例中选择针对问题的推理策略，只在确有必要时投入更多推理计算。
why: It replaces a fixed think-long-or-think-short policy with per-question strategy selection and reports both quality and time.
inclusion_reason: It directly allocates reasoning depth and context-processing effort at inference according to an automatically selected strategy.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Contextual question answering contains both direct questions that need a short grounded lookup and multi-hop questions that require substantial decomposition and synthesis. A single inference policy wastes resources at one end of this spectrum: always producing elaborate chains adds irrelevant steps and can introduce spurious evidence for simple questions, while always answering quickly leaves hard questions under-reasoned. Fixed token limits and hand-designed early-stop rules reduce some waste, but they decide in advance what the model should consider difficult.

The paper asks how a model can choose its own appropriate reasoning depth for a new document-question pair. The decision target is not merely whether to stop generating tokens. It is which reasoning strategy, including the required subquestions and evidence focus, should guide the answer; the selected strategy is meant to allocate concise processing to straightforward questions and more detailed computation to structurally complex ones.

上下文问答同时包含只需简短、基于证据查找即可回答的问题，以及必须进行充分分解和综合的多跳问题。单一的推理策略会在这一范围的两端浪费资源：对所有问题都写复杂思维链，会为简单问题加入无关步骤，甚至引入虚假证据；对所有问题都快速作答，又会让困难问题的推理不足。固定令牌上限和人工设计的早停规则虽能减少部分浪费，却是预先替模型决定什么问题应被视为困难。

论文研究模型如何为新的文档—问题对自行选择恰当的推理深度。它要决定的不只是何时停止生成令牌，而是选择哪种推理策略来引导作答，其中包括需要哪些子问题以及应聚焦哪些证据。所选策略应让直接问题采用简洁处理，让结构复杂的问题获得更细致的计算。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
T2, named Think-to-Think, treats a new question as an instance of a structural pattern rather than assigning it to a predefined difficulty bucket. It first separates fixed structure from replaceable entities, then creates analogous question-document examples that preserve the structure while varying those entities. Each example carries a candidate solution plan with a potentially different number of reasoning steps, allowing the system to compare ways of thinking instead of blindly extending one chain.

The selected plan is used as a test-time control object. It specifies a sequence of reasoning skills and tells the answering model which parts of the original document are relevant to those skills. Thus adaptation comes from matching the original question to a generated strategy whose coverage and uniqueness score is favorable. The key claim is that similar problems provide a model-native signal for when concise reasoning is enough and when a longer, evidence-focused analysis is worth its cost.

T2 的全称为 Think-to-Think，它把新问题视为某种结构模式的实例，而不是将其分配到预先定义的难度桶中。系统先分离固定结构和可替换实体，再生成保持同一结构、但替换实体的类似问题—文档示例。每个示例都带有候选解题方案，其中推理步骤数量可能不同；因此系统比较不同的思考方式，而非盲目延长同一条思维链。

被选中的方案在推理时充当控制对象。它给出一系列推理技能，并告诉回答模型原始文档中哪些部分与这些技能相关。因此，适应性来自把原问题与覆盖性和独特性评分较优的生成策略相匹配。其关键主张是：类似问题能提供一种模型自身的信号，判断何时简洁推理已足够，何时更长且聚焦证据的分析值得付出成本。

title: Method
方法
html:
For a document D and question Q, T2 uses a fine-tuned RoBERTa classifier to divide question tokens into structural tokens and typed entity placeholders, yielding a reusable question template. An LLM replaces those entities to create candidate similar questions, and a similarity check keeps only candidates above a threshold. For each retained question, the method creates supporting document segments and decomposes the problem into subquestions connected by one of seven stated reasoning skills. The number of subquestions is deliberately not fixed, which supplies strategies of different depths.

T2 evaluates the resulting example-strategy collection with multiple criteria, reported as coverage and uniqueness, and retrieves the best strategy for the original question. At answer time it extracts from D the text segments relevant to each selected skill, creates a prompt containing the original question, focused context, analogous example, and strategy, then lets an LLM produce the answer. The computation record is therefore template, analogous example, candidate plan, score, focused evidence, and answer; it gives the system visible handles for controlling the amount and direction of inference work.

对于文档 D 和问题 Q，T2 使用微调后的 RoBERTa 分类器，把问题令牌划分为结构令牌和带类型的实体占位符，从而得到可复用的问题模板。语言模型替换这些实体以生成候选类似问题，再通过相似度检查只保留超过阈值的候选。对于每个保留问题，方法生成支持性文档片段，并把问题拆为由七种已说明推理技能之一连接的子问题。子问题数量被有意设计为不固定，从而形成深度不同的策略。

T2 用多项标准评估生成的示例—策略集合，论文将其表述为覆盖性和独特性，并为原问题取回最佳策略。作答时，它从 D 中抽取与每项选定技能相关的文本片段，构造包含原问题、聚焦上下文、类似示例和策略的提示，再由语言模型给出答案。因此，计算记录包括模板、类似示例、候选方案、评分、聚焦证据和答案；这些记录为控制推理工作的数量与方向提供了可见接口。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official EMNLP paper evaluates T2 on seven contextual QA datasets: SQuAD, HotpotQA, NewsQA, Gaokao, HQA, TriviaQA, and BioASQ. It compares Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct and GPT-4o configurations with direct prompting, few-shot prompting, chain-of-thought variants, self-consistency, proCoT, Tree of Thoughts, and MCTS; it also reports results when adding T2 to QwQ-32B-Preview. The reported table shows higher ROUGE-L values for T2 across the listed Qwen2.5-32B settings and most stated comparison conditions.

The efficiency evidence is not only a token assertion. The paper reports average inference time: on Qwen2.5-32B, T2 takes 34.52 seconds versus 78.92 seconds for MCTS, a 56.3% reduction; on QwQ-32B it reports 45.03 versus 90.58 seconds, a 50.3% reduction. Its abstract summarizes a reduction of computational overhead by up to 25.2%, while the introduction reports up to 21.3% accuracy improvement over other test-time strategies. These results are task-specific comparisons, so a deployment decision should reproduce the strategy-generation cost and answer-quality metrics on its own corpus.

官方 EMNLP 论文在七个上下文问答数据集上评测 T2：SQuAD、HotpotQA、NewsQA、Gaokao、HQA、TriviaQA 和 BioASQ。它将 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 与 GPT-4o 的配置，同直接提示、少样本提示、思维链变体、自一致性、proCoT、思维树和 MCTS 比较；也报告了在 QwQ-32B-Preview 上加入 T2 的结果。论文表格显示，在列出的 Qwen2.5-32B 配置和多数所述比较条件中，T2 的 ROUGE-L 分数更高。

效率证据并不只是令牌层面的断言。论文报告平均推理时间：在 Qwen2.5-32B 上，T2 为 34.52 秒，MCTS 为 78.92 秒，减少 56.3%；在 QwQ-32B 上则为 45.03 秒和 90.58 秒，减少 50.3%。摘要概述计算开销最高可减少 25.2%，引言则报告相对其他推理时策略的准确率提升最高达 21.3%。这些结果是特定任务上的比较，因此部署决策仍应在自身语料上复现策略生成成本和答案质量指标。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
T2 differs from a simple early-exit controller because it does not only predict a scalar budget or a stop point. It generates and selects an explicit reasoning plan from structurally analogous questions. The plan carries the intended subproblem structure and reasoning skills, and it determines which evidence should enter the final prompt. This turns test-time adaptation into a choice over inspectable strategy records rather than a hidden rule that merely shortens every chain.

The paper also makes contextual QA, rather than only mathematical answer search, the setting for adaptive scaling. Its mechanism couples structural parsing, synthetic analogues, multi-criteria selection, and focused context extraction. The distinctive contribution is the claim that the same model family can use its performance on generated analogues to choose the depth of processing for a new question, thereby treating strategy selection itself as an inference-time allocation decision.

T2 不同于简单的早停控制器，因为它不只是预测一个标量预算或停止点。它从结构相似的问题中生成并选择显式推理方案。该方案带有预期的子问题结构和推理技能，并决定哪些证据应进入最终提示。这使推理时适应成为对可检查策略记录的选择，而不是一条只会缩短每条思维链的隐藏规则。

论文还把自适应扩展放在上下文问答而非仅限数学答案搜索的场景中。其机制结合了结构解析、合成类比、多标准选择和聚焦上下文提取。其独特贡献在于主张：同一模型家族能够利用自己在生成类比问题上的表现，为新问题选择处理深度，从而把策略选择本身视为一种推理时计算分配决策。

title: Limitations
局限
html: T2 adds several generation, validation, and selection steps before answering, so its claimed savings depend on the relative cost of those steps, the base model, and the comparison policy. Its synthetic similar questions and generated support documents can be malformed, insufficiently analogous, or factually unreliable, while the structural parser and seven-skill taxonomy may not express every question type. The evaluation focuses on contextual QA benchmarks and reported time comparisons; it does not establish that the same strategy-selection signal transfers unchanged to tool use, free-form writing, mathematical proof, or environments where evidence cannot be cleanly extracted from a supplied document.
T2 在作答前增加了若干生成、验证和选择步骤，因此其节省效果取决于这些步骤的相对成本、基础模型以及比较策略。它合成的类似问题和生成的支持文档可能格式错误、相似性不足或事实不可靠；结构解析器和七种技能的分类法也未必能表达所有问题类型。评测集中于上下文问答基准和所报告的时间比较，并未证明同一策略选择信号能够原样迁移到工具使用、自由写作、数学证明，或证据无法从给定文档中干净抽取的环境。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: T2 is useful for applications that answer document-grounded questions with widely varying structural complexity and need a traceable alternative to fixed chain-of-thought budgets. A replication should log the parsed template, generated analogues, rejected candidates, selected plan, extracted evidence segments, prompts, model calls, tokens, latency, and final answer. That audit trail lets a team compare a plan-selection policy with a direct budget predictor, identify whether expensive planning is being used only on difficult cases, and replace individual components without losing the connection between observed cost and the reasoning decision that caused it.
T2 适合回答文档支撑、结构复杂度差异很大的问题，并且需要一种可追踪替代方案来取代固定思维链预算的应用。复现实验应记录解析出的模板、生成的类比、被拒绝的候选、选中的方案、抽取的证据片段、提示、模型调用、令牌、延迟和最终答案。这条审计轨迹可让团队将方案选择策略与直接预算预测器比较，判断昂贵的规划是否真的只用于困难案例，并在不失去成本与其所对应推理决策之间联系的情况下替换个别组件。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: When reading the full paper, separate the cost of selecting a strategy from the cost of executing the selected answer plan. Inspect the exact prompts and thresholds for analogous-question generation, similarity validation, coverage, uniqueness, and evidence extraction; these determine whether adaptation is genuinely question-specific or largely a fixed overhead. The most useful reproduction reports accuracy, grounded-evidence precision and recall, strategy depth, number of generated analogues, tokens, API calls, and wall-clock time per difficulty band. It should also test whether strategy choice remains useful when the source documents are noisy or when the required reasoning skill falls outside the stated taxonomy.
阅读全文时，应把选择策略的成本与执行所选答案方案的成本分开。需要检查生成类似问题、相似度验证、覆盖性、独特性和证据抽取所使用的确切提示与阈值；这些设置决定适应性究竟真正因问题而异，还是大多只是固定开销。最有价值的复现应按难度区间报告准确率、基于证据的精确率与召回率、策略深度、生成类比数量、令牌、接口调用和实际时间。它还应检验当源文档有噪声，或所需推理技能不在既定分类法中时，策略选择是否仍然有效。
